about_the_game:
The story begins during a period when the protagonist is undergoing medication treatment in a hospital room. With each dose, he drifts further from reality, slipping into an imaginary world constructed by his own mind. This world is silent, sterile, yet oddly peaceful — a mental refuge built to escape the chaos of real life.

  • As the player navigates between these two realms —the real and the imagined— they are brought to a critical choice:

Will they confront their past and return to reality, or become lost in the safe, yet illusory waters of their own mind?


Close to reality, full of emotion. Developed with Unity 6 HDRP, this scene aims to draw you in with visual reality and atmosphere.



Take a break to manage your sanity and observe the unsettling silence.

  • Solve encrypted clues hidden in paintings and symbols.

  • Climb your way through crumbling environments and unstable structures.

  • Use the handheld camera to reveal messages invisible to the naked eye.

A blinding light opens the path to a forgotten memory. But are you ready to face it?

This is just the beginning. The rest of the story is waiting for you to discover. Are you ready to face the past? The journey into the depths of the mind is just beginning. Escaping reality is easy… but returning is not always possible. Only you can find what awaits you in the forgotten rooms.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: İntel i5 or AMD ryzon 5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia gtx 1060 or amd radeon rx 580 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-14900K - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Ti - AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: RME Fireface UFX II

short_description: The Forgotten Rooms is a psychological exploration game about a character diagnosed with schizophrenia who struggles with his traumas. He escapes reality with medication and confronts his past in the imaginary world of “poolrooms”..
